messages:
leo (Marketing): Heads-up: launching the inference benchmark next Wed. Need social plan for X + LinkedIn + 1-thread highlights doc. Goal: drive webinar signups + report downloads.

jess (Social): Cool. Proposed deliverables: hero post, 2 reminders, a 5-tweet thread summarizing 3 key findings, and a recording highlight clip post. Also need variants for technical vs product audiences.

nina (Design): I'll make a hero image + a short MP4 clip (10s) for the recording highlight. ETA: tomorrow noon. Need exact copy.

leo (Marketing): Copy asks: 2 short X hooks (one technical, one human), 1 LinkedIn long-form, and short thread bullets (each tweet <= 280 chars). Also include CTAs for webinar + download link.

jess (Social): Draft copies below. Feedback quick pls.

X - technical:
"New benchmark: tradeoffs between latency and cost across open models. See our methodology & actionable ops tips. Register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inf_bench_apr"

X - product:
"We compared open models on speed and price. Surprising winners + practical tips to shave inference cost. Live webinar Wed. Seats: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"

LinkedIn:
"We ran a large-scale inference benchmark across popular open models to measure latency, throughput, and per-token cost. Join our webinar for an in-depth walkthrough of the results and concrete steps engineering teams can take to optimize inference economics. Speakers: Mira (Applied ML), Dan (Runtime). Register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"

Thread (tweet 1): New benchmark out: cost vs latency across open models. TL;DR: you can cut cost with batching + quantization without losing latency for many workloads. Register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar
Thread (tweet 2): Methodology: 10 models, 3 sequence lengths, 2 batch profiles. We measured p99 latency, throughput, and cost/token.
Thread (tweet 3): Top takeaway: smart routing + lightweight quantization gives the best cost/latency tradeoff for chat-style workloads.
Thread (tweet 4): Want the config? We'll publish a notebook and sample YAMLs. Join the webinar to get early access.
Thread (tweet 5): Recording + report will be available after the event. Tagging partners and authors in replies.

omar (Growth): Paid plan: boost hero + thread lead tweet. Budget: $800. Target: ML engineers, infra/platform engs, cloud infra audiences. Need approval from finance.

chris (Sales): Routing: webinar signups -> SFDC list "Benchmark Webinar - Marketing". Create lead type: show_interest=true and include fields: company_size, role, use_case. SDRs get a daily digest.

leo (Marketing): Good. Add hidden field lead_src=inf_bench_apr and utm params on all social links. Jess, please append UTMs to the links.

jess (Social): Done in drafts. Example: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=inf_bench_apr&utm_content=hero_post

nina (Design): Uploaded hero.png and clip.mp4 -> https://files.redwood.ai/bench/apr_assets.zip. Also made two color treatments (blue / charcoal). Which one for LinkedIn?

leo (Marketing): Use blue for LinkedIn, charcoal for X. Also make a square crop for in-feed.

jess (Social): Engagement plan: first-hour team replies by Omar + Sales for lead followups, saved replies for common Qs (where to get report, will code be published, is this enterprise-ready). After event, thread the top clip + pin.

omar (Growth): I'll handle first-hour replies and monitor for high-intent comments to pass to Sales.

post-bot: Scheduled post created: 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC -> LinkedIn hero draft.

chris (Sales): For SDRs: please include the exact SFDC queue name in the webhook: "Benchmark_Webinar_Leads". Also request tag "audience=dev".

leo (Marketing): Will update the form + webhook fields. Chris, can your team confirm they can ingest use_case values?

chris (Sales): Yes. We'll map use_case -> campaign tier.

jess (Social): Final ask before scheduling: approve copy variants and attach the hero image. Also confirm paid boost audience.

leo (Marketing): Approve technical X copy for dev channel, product copy for growth channel, LinkedIn copy approved. Omar, budget ok?

omar (Growth): Approved $800 pending finance sign-off. I'll send audience list by EOD.

nina (Design): Files ready; uploading the square crops now.

jess (Social): I'll schedule hero + first reminder once assets and UTMs are final. Will also prepare the 5-tweet thread as a scheduled thread (threaded API).

leo (Marketing): Post-event ownership: Sales -> outreach, Social -> amplify highlights, Growth -> retargeting. Please add action items to the launch Notion: https://notion.redwood.ai/marketing/inf-bench-apr.

jess (Social): Added calendar entries and scheduled drafts. Leaving thread open for any last-minute changes.

leo (Marketing): Thanks everyone. React with :white_check_mark: when you completed your action.

omar (Growth): :white_check_mark:

nina (Design): :white_check_mark:

chris (Sales): :white_check_mark:

jess (Social): :white_check_mark:
